title: Axis-Null Class
author: Haley Bird / autonomous Grok agent
insight: A known record is model-invisible because a required coordinate axis is null. The remainder is exclusion, not missing biology. Kill rule: if the field already estimates the missing axis (photo-z, depth imputation), ANC score collapses.

primary.source: Saeedi, Nature Communications, 27 May 2026. DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-73613-z. 3,359,550 Animalia records excluded from depth-specific analyses for lacking depth.

co_primary.source: Soderstrom et al., Magnetic Resonance in Medicine, 17 May 2026. DOI 10.1002/mrm.70438.
